completion_guidance: Educational company-level comparison only. All entry cells are blank; this is not a researched list or delivery approval.
Do not enter live customer lists; customer identity; personal data; order history; confidential pricing; identifiable site details; or client secrets. Use only an authorised generalised seed profile.

Open as UTF-8 and preserve identifiers as text. Enter applicable rules in the seed column; candidate observations and decisions in candidate columns. Repeat the evidence block per additional source and reuse evidence IDs in criterion rows.
Enter the agreed brief reference and version. Apply the same rules to all candidates; record a changed scope as a new version.
Seed column only: reference the controlled authorisation for this use. Do not paste underlying customer records or confidential permission documents.
Seed column only: explain which potentially identifying or confidential details were omitted or generalised. An unnamed profile can still reveal a client.
Seed column: explain why the profile is relevant beyond a one-off sale. Candidate columns: record only the bounded relevance hypothesis; not a claim of buying intent.
Seed column: record company as the unit for this guide. Keep relevant sites attached to the company; candidate slots are not distinct-company counts.
Candidate columns only: stable company-level record reference. Do not enter the real seed customer's name.
Candidate columns only: identify the relevant operating site and the supported company relationship where permitted; do not assume a group operates every site.
Candidate columns only: evidence IDs supporting the company identity and site attribution. Shared names are not enough.
Candidate columns only: state resolved; unknown; or conflicting with explanation. Identify any confirmed duplicate anchor without counting another account.
Seed column: required activity. Candidate columns: permitted observation about actual activity; not a product-word inference.
Candidate columns only: evidence IDs that support or challenge the activity observation. Link to the evidence blocks below.
Candidate columns only: supported; contradicted; unknown; or conflicting with a reason against the seed rule.
Seed column: required role such as contract finisher or in-house manufacturer. Candidate columns: permitted observation about the actual role.
Candidate columns only: evidence IDs supporting or challenging the customer role. Do not infer procurement authority from activity.
Candidate columns only: supported; contradicted; unknown; or conflicting with a reason against the seed rule.
Seed column: territory and required operating presence. Candidate columns: permitted observation about relevant operations rather than only a sales address.
Candidate columns only: evidence IDs attributing the relevant activity and location to this company.
Candidate columns only: supported; contradicted; unknown; or conflicting with a reason against the seed rule.
Add a block with rule; observation; evidence references; and assessment for any additional required criterion before research. Do not hide a requirement in optional preferences.

Seed column: a meaningful optional discriminator and why it matters. Candidate columns: observation; evidence reference; and whether it affects ordering only. Leave unknown rather than infer size or budget.
Seed column: superficial or non-transferable features. Candidate columns: note tempting but unsupported similarities that must not decide the fit.
Seed column: general exclusion rules and controlled workflow reference. Candidate columns: check result and reference only. Do not paste customer or conflict lists.
Start of repeatable evidence block. Candidate columns: unique reference for one source and its supported claim. Repeat this whole block for additional sources.
Candidate columns: actual reviewed source URL or controlled reference. No fabricated citations; leave blank until reviewed. Keep confidential evidence in its permitted environment.
Candidate columns: actual source publication date if known. Leave blank if unknown; do not substitute review date.
Candidate columns: date this source was actually reviewed. Never enter a planned check date as completed research.
Candidate columns: intended retained or customer use and the relevant access/use terms reference. Public availability is not permission to copy or redistribute.
Candidate columns: record applicable limits and the outcome of the intended-use check. Leave source-content observation blank while permission is unresolved.
Candidate columns: concise permitted observation only after source-use checks. Preserve exact scope and attribution; do not copy substantial source text.
Candidate columns: specify the activity; role; territory; identity; or other criterion this source supports or challenges. Multiple sources can address one criterion.
Candidate columns: separate your inference from the observed fact. Record scope limits; group-versus-site ambiguity; missing dates; or contradictions.
End of repeatable evidence block. Candidate columns: a concrete unresolved question or additional check; leave blank only when none remains for this source.
Candidate columns: summarise identity; required criteria; exclusions; source-use posture; and material consistency. Do not let an optional score override an unresolved or failed requirement.

Candidate columns: shortlist; hold; or reject with reasons. Shortlist requires resolved required checks. Hold material uncertainty. Reject a supported non-match; do not investigate unrelated optional details merely to justify rejection.
Candidate columns: explain transferable fit; the positively failed rule; or the missing/conflicting fact. A shared word is not a fit reason.
Candidate columns: optional separate hypothesis for a rejected adjacent company. It does not change the current brief or current decision.
Candidate columns: distinguish not assessed-not required from a bounded review with no qualifying signal found or a separately evidenced signal. Neither absence statement proves no project exists.
Candidate columns: actual evidence references only if a project signal was assessed. Account fit does not prove current projects; package availability; or demand.
Candidate columns: record separately established technical facts and remaining unknowns. Matching processes do not prove equipment compatibility or installed equipment.
Candidate columns: record the separate clearance boundary or control reference if genuinely assessed. This worksheet grants no contact or outreach permission; do not enter personal contact details.
Candidate columns: next verification question and responsible internal role rather than a person's details. Do not invent assigned dates or claim monitoring is active.
Candidate columns: actual agreed trigger for reconsidering the decision. Keep missing timing unknown; a proposed trigger is not a completed check.
Separate release decision/control reference if genuinely made in the authorised workflow. Research fit is not delivery approval. Do not prefill an approved status.
